title: The Uneven Impact of Industrial Zones on Formal Job Creation in Vietnam
title_zh: 越南工业区对正规就业创造的不均衡影响
authors: Brian McCaig, Margaret S. McMillan, Marina Mavungu Ngoma, Anh T. Pham
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Industrial zones are a widely used industrial policy tool, yet their effects vary enormously. Matching the timing and location of zone establishment to firm-level data in Vietnam, we estimate that a new zone raises formal employment by 2,000 workers within seven years. This average masks extreme skewness: a handful of zones generate the gains while the rest produce almost none. Zones near major trade hubs account for most of the effect, driven by export-oriented foreign manufacturers. Accounting for spillovers, domestic firms face agglomeration shadows nearby but gain farther out, while foreign manufacturers operate as enclaves, generating few local linkages.
abstract_zh: 工业区是一种广泛使用的产业政策工具，但其效果差异巨大。通过将越南工业区设立的时间与地点与企业层面数据进行匹配，我们估算出新建工业区在七年内可使正规就业增加2000人。这一平均值掩盖了极端偏态分布：少数工业区贡献了全部增长，其余工业区几乎毫无成效。靠近主要贸易枢纽的工业区贡献了大部分效应，其驱动力来自出口导向型外资制造商。考虑溢出效应后，国内企业在邻近区域面临集聚阴影，但在更远距离处获益；而外资制造商以飞地模式运营，几乎未产生本地关联。

title: Choice Between Public and Private Healthcare Systems: Evidence from Veterans
title_zh: 公共与私人医疗体系的选择：来自退伍军人的证据
authors: Marika Cabral, David C. Chan Jr, Seth Neller
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the choice between public and private healthcare systems among elderly veterans, who are dually eligible to obtain care through the publicly operated Veterans Health Administration (VA) and through private providers financed by Medicare. We analyze health system choice among veterans who move across areas with differing rates of VA utilization to quantify the relative importance of individual-specific factors (e.g., preferences, income, health) and place-specific factors (e.g., local access, quality, and convenience). Our estimates indicate that 50–60% of geographic variation in VA use is attributable to demand-side individual factors, with the remainder explained by place-based factors. We also document important heterogeneity across types of care, with place-based factors playing a larger role for inpatient and emergency care than for outpatient and primary care. Additional analysis suggests that the supply-side features emphasized in recent legislation—distance to VA facilities and wait times—explain only a small share of estimated place effects. These findings highlight the importance of individual factors in health system choice and have implications for policies aimed at reducing geographic disparities in VA utilization.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了老年退伍军人在公共与私营医疗体系之间的选择问题。这些退伍军人有资格通过公立的退伍军人健康管理局（VA）以及由医疗保险资助的私营医疗机构获得医疗服务。我们分析了在不同VA使用率地区间迁移的退伍军人的医疗体系选择，以量化个体特定因素（如偏好、收入、健康状况）和地区特定因素（如当地可及性、质量及便利性）的相对重要性。估算结果表明，VA使用的地理差异中50%–60%可归因于需求侧的个体因素，其余部分则由地区因素解释。我们还发现不同医疗类型之间存在显著异质性：地区因素对住院和急诊服务的影响大于对门诊和初级保健服务的影响。进一步分析表明，近期立法强调的供给侧特征——与VA机构的距离及等待时间——仅能解释地区效应的一小部分。这些发现凸显了个体因素在医疗体系选择中的重要性，并对旨在减少VA使用地理差异的政策具有启示意义。

                    Mitigation in Agriculture: Incentive Design, Economic Benefits and Behavioural Responses
title_zh: 农业温室气体减排经济学：激励设计、经济效益与行为响应
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
abstract: ABSTRACT This special issue examines the economics of greenhouse gas (GHG) mitigation in agriculture. The papers in the issue study agricultural mitigation from three broad perspectives: the design of mitigation incentives, the economic benefits of mitigation practices and programmes, and the adoption and behavioural responses by producers, consumers and other stakeholders. The papers span a wide range of countries, production systems and policy contexts, and collectively show that translating mitigation potential into mitigation outcomes depends critically on incentive design, measurement and the actions across producers, consumers, regulators and supply‐chain actors.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本期特刊探讨农业领域温室气体减排的经济学问题。所收录论文从三大视角研究农业减排：减排激励机制设计、减排实践与项目的经济效益，以及生产者、消费者及其他利益相关方的采纳行为与响应。这些研究覆盖多个国家、生产体系及政策背景，共同表明：将减排潜力转化为实际减排成效，关键取决于激励机制设计、核算方法，以及生产者、消费者、监管机构和供应链参与者的协同行动。

title: Location Effects or Sorting? Evidence from Firm Relocation
title_zh: 区位效应还是分类效应？来自企业搬迁的证据
authors: Pauline Carry, Benny Kleinman, Elio Nimier-David, Pauline Carry; Benny Kleinman; Elio Nimier-David
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: What role do firms play in geographic wage disparities? This paper exploits establishment mobility as a novel source of identification to separate firm sorting from location treatment effects, i.e., the local wage premium for a given worker at a given firm (due to, e.g., geography, infrastructure, amenities). Using data from France and the U.S., we first document key facts about establishment relocation: 4% of establishments move each year, retaining their activity and structure while adjusting their workforce and wages. Combining establishment and worker mobility in France, we estimate a model that decomposes wage variation due to workers, firms, and locations. Spatial wage differences are primarily driven by sorting: worker composition accounts for 30%, firm composition for 17%, and their co-location for 34%. Residual location effects explain only 2–4%. Establishment sorting also accounts for most of the urban wage premium and the higher wage growth in larger cities.

title: A Unified Approach to Estimating Production Functions: Proxy Variables and Dynamic Panel Data
title_zh: 生产函数估计的统一方法：代理变量与动态面板数据
abstract: ABSTRACT We propose a new approach to production function estimation that integrates the strengths of the proxy‐variable (PV) and dynamic panel data (DPD) methods. Our framework augments the set of instruments for the level equation in Blundell and Bond [8] with a Berkson‐type instrument motivated by economic theory, following Olley and Pakes [28], Levinsohn and Petrin [24], and Ackerberg et al. [4]. This modification allows unobserved productivity to include both a time‐invariant (“fixed‐effect”) component and a time‐varying component that follows a potentially nonlinear Markov process. Whereas the PV approach accommodates nonlinear Markov dynamics but not fixed effects, and the DPD approach accounts for fixed effects but only with linear Markov dynamics, our method relaxes both restrictions. Our estimator is straightforward to implement using GMM. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that it outperforms the canonical PV and DPD estimators when productivity persistence is low and fixed‐effect heterogeneity is substantial.
